results.title: Real D1 persistence + atomic quota under concurrency
results.expected: exactly 10 granted; restart persistence; workspace isolation
results.actual: Not run against D1: missing CF_ACCOUNT_ID, D1_DATABASE_ID, CF_API_TOKEN

evidence.note: SQLite result proves the script and the SQL, NOT D1 behaviour.

results.unblock: Create the D1 database, apply workers/pipeline/migrations, then export these variables in the shell that runs this script.

results.title: Genuine photo → generated background → preserved product → approved asset
results.input: genuine product photographs (e.g. Apple product photos you are licensed to use)
results.expected: protected pixels unchanged; background labelled by kind; human approval
results.actual: No photos: set ACCEPT_PHOTOS to a folder of genuine photos.
results.unblock: Provide photos you own or are licensed to use. Optional: ground-truth masks for segmentation IoU.

results.title: Real social data → source-backed trend and regional recommendation (Apple / India)
results.expected: opportunities with source URL, timestamp, evidence, geo basis, trend vs baseline, cost
results.actual: Not run: X_BEARER_TOKEN is not set.
results.unblock: Create an X developer app on a paid tier and export X_BEARER_TOKEN (app-only bearer).

results.title: Authorized, approved test post published and verified by external post id
results.input: one approved test post from the designated test account
results.expected: job reaches completed with provider post id read back from X
results.actual: Not run. Needs a person to connect the test account in Settings → Connections and approve the post.
results.unblock: Set X_CLIENT_ID/X_CLIENT_SECRET, X_ALLOWED_ACCOUNT=@test_account, X_PUBLISH_ENABLED=1; connect the account; draft → approve → Publish now; record the post id.
